findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_extracted_company_data · Private data: check_identifier_format, parse_efactura, get_bnr_exchange_rate, get_robor, get_ircc · Public sink: generate_efactura · Destructive: check_identifier_format.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_extracted_company_data · Private data: check_identifier_format, parse_efactura, get_bnr_exchange_rate, get_robor, get_ircc · Public sink: generate_efactura · Destructive: check_identifier_format

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_bnr_exchange_rate" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "BNR reference exchange rates in RON from 2005-01-03: one date (latest fixing on/before the date; all currencies or one), or a daily series for one currency with from/to (max 366 days). Free (0 credits). Source: Banca Națională a României (bnr.ro); informational, values unchanged from BNR source." → after: "BNR reference exchange rates in RON from 2005-01-03: one date (latest fixing on/before the date; all currencies or one), or a daily series for one currency with from/to (max 366 days). Free (0 credits); works without an API key (keyless calls are rate-limited per IP). Source: Banca Națională a Român"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
